notes.title: UPDATE #5
notes.content:
The new location is ready for exploration.
In this abandoned place you will find a lot of different loot and dangerous creatures. (loot is only available in the new game)

Various bugs have also been fixed:

[list]
[*] Various bugs with animals have been fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug with growing vegetables.
[*] Fixed a bug with disappearing textures
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Various bugs with animals have been fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug with growing vegetables.
[*] Fixed a bug with disappearing textures

notes.title: New update - Caves
notes.content:
[b]New update - Caves.[/b]

[list]
[*] An early version of the caves is ready for exploration. Here you can find some new resources and fight underground creatures.
[*] The dungeon will be constantly expanded with the new update. In the first version there will be only 1 entrance and exit from the cave.
[*] The storyline will be closely related to the dungeon.
[/list]

[u][b]IMPORTANT: ERROR IN THE CAVE WITH SAVING!!!
Before entering the cave, save the game in a new slot! Otherwise, if you die inside the cave, you will lose all your houses and things! I will look into this error![/b][/u]

tags.feature: An early version of the caves is ready for exploration. Here you can find some new resources and fight underground creatures.
The dungeon will be constantly expanded with the new update. In the first version there will be only 1 entrance and exit from the cave.
The storyline will be closely related to the dungeon.

tags.bug: Before entering the cave, save the game in a new slot! Otherwise, if you die inside the cave, you will lose all your houses and things! I will look into this error!

notes.title: UPDATE #3.2
notes.content:
- Added new items:
- Changed the mechanics of animals;

notes.title: UPDATE #3.1

tags.balance_change: - Predators have an increased detection radius of prey;
- The decomposition time of products has been changed (now it is stored even longer);

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug with bread (it used to quench your thirst).

notes.title: UPDATE #3

tags.feature: - Added a small settlement of skeletons and loot (Loot is displayed only in the new game);

tags.balance_change: - Crafting has been balanced (now less resources are required to create most items);

notes.title: UPDATE #2

tags.feature: - Added new walking animation for some animals;
- Added sounds of animals walking and running;

tags.balance_change: - Changed the distance of the player being pursued by enemies;
- Updated mechanics of behavior of animals and entities;
- Crafting has been balanced (now it takes less resources to craft some items);

tags.bug: - Fixed the “skeleton” of the bear (now falls after death);

tags.feature: - Added new cute beds for vegetables;

tags.bug: - Fixed animal attacks (previously stopped in front of the player);

notes.title: BUG FIXES #4

tags.bug: - Fixed FVX of the skeleton (when walking and running, dust from under the feet was not displayed);
- Fixed the disappearance of loot in the form of a falling bag, now it does not fly off and does not fall under the ground texture;
- Fixed and added interaction sounds (example: chopping a tree);

tags.feature: - Added new music to the background;

tags.balance_change: - Changed the beds to be more attractive and fixed the time for growing vegetables.

notes.title: BUG FIX #2:

tags.bug: - Fixed the extraction of mined resources (now the wood does not disappear);
- Fixed the time of appearance of skeletons;
- Fixed tool set (now lasts longer);

tags.feature: - Added new tools (metal pickaxe and axe);

tags.balance_change: - Changed leaf production (no longer falls from trees);

notes.title: UPDATE #1

tags.balance_change: - Reducing the height of thick grass;
- Now the day lasts a little longer and the night a little shorter;
- Changing the mechanics of animals and creatures;

tags.bug: - Fixed decay time of all products;
- Fixed a bug with getting large amounts of meat from pigs;
- Fixed a bug with crafting a shovel;

tags.feature: - Added a simple tent for respawn;
- Added a new type of skeletons;
- Removing the mini-map due to its uselessness;

notes.title: FIX MECHANICS

tags.bug: [*] Amount of drop-down loot;
[*] Changing the crafting of the character;

tags.feature: [*] The spawn point can now be placed on the ground.

notes.title: BUG FIX #1

tags.bug: [*] Impact sounds;
